scope: Pinned native fixture only; no application instrumentation or ownership proof
nextAction: Prototype a private native scalar-read observer with explicit callback-loss detection. Require read/reflection equivalence, original value/flags preservation, no application getter/trap invocation during guard checks, callback error and microtask isolation, alias/foreign-context handling and lifetime tests before workload integration.
limitations: The native fixture supplies one string value on one null-prototype object; it is not an installed observer for arbitrary application objects.
Writes and property redefinition can remove the native callback. A future observer must detect this and reject incomplete evidence.
Callbacks installed before observation, earlier value copies and native capability integrity remain unproven.
No workload change, replay authority or product savings measurement.
